snippet.title: FIREFIGHT RELOADED: ENDGAME - GAMEPLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
Witness some of the first finalized gameplay of FIREFIGHT RELOADED: ENDGAME, an update coming for FIREFIGHT RELOADED later this year! Introducing new gameplay mechanics, new enemy types, a native Linux port, and more, this new update will be worth the weight.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/397680/FIREFIGHT_RELOADED/
Song: https://bitl.bandcamp.com/track/disruptor-from-the-firefight-reloaded-endgame-ost
